Counsel for the applicant has tried to argue the matter on merits, but no substantial change in circumstances has been pointed out.
3. It also transpires that the earlier bail application was withdrawn on 06.01.2026 and within a month of such withdrawal, the present application seeking anticipatory bail has been filed.

Filing of repeated anticipatory bail applications, while evading arrest, and more particularly when the earlier bail NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:10417 2 MCRC-5612-2026 application was already dismissed as withdrawn, itself speaks volumes.
4. It is also relevant to note that even the applicant is doing activity as Developer and has continued with his business of developing other properties.
Even then, the reason best known to the Investigating Officer, no action is taken in the matter.

5.
